VBO:0200372.summary: English and American Cocker Spaniels share a history as compact sporting dogs used to hunt birds in cover. They developed into separate breeds; which one is called simply “Cocker Spaniel” depends on the country.
VBO:0200372.shortDescription: English and American Cockers share sporting roots but are separate breeds with different naming traditions.

sources.title: AKC — English Cocker Spaniel vs. Cocker Spaniel
sources.evidence: Read opening and development paragraphs: US/non-US naming distinction, two separately recognized breeds, shared land-spaniel origins and small cockers hunting woodcock/heavy cover; no suitability claims imported.
